title: [UI/UX] support is required to design the Loss Adjuster Rating survey experience within the Provider Management module.

walkthroughSteps.title: Rate this adjuster
walkthroughSteps.body: Once a loss adjuster's assignment is eligible for review, a rating action appears alongside their row.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Opens the loss adjuster rating survey modal.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Eligible provider assignments show a Rate this adjuster action
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: When a provider assignment is eligible for review, **Rate this adjuster** appears next to Send communication on that row.

setup.description: Uses CLM-2024-001's existing provider assignments — no override needed

preconditions.text: At least one provider row shows Rate this adjuster

expectedUI.description: Rating survey modal opens for an eligible assignment
visualCues: Rate this adjuster button visible on eligible rows

howToTest.trigger: Click Rate this adjuster on an eligible provider row
howToTest.expectedResult: Loss adjuster rating survey modal opens
